name: criss cross stepback hops
description: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Alternate sides for the planned time.
